$comment: Owner-merge paths (docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md §23.1, D50, D61, D81, D82). A pull request that touches one changes the pipeline, code a privileged job runs, or what every later agent obeys: owner-merge.yml labels it owner-merge and turns its auto-merge off, change detection never calls it docs-only, and Dependabot's auto-merge refuses it. The owner merges it after reading the diff, or the session acting for the owner does after two independent security reviews of its head commit (D81). A `**` segment stands for any number of directories, none included: `dir/**` is everything under dir, `**/CLAUDE.md` is a CLAUDE.md at any depth, the root included, and other entries are exact files. Matched without case. Always read from the base branch. `branches` is the release PR's branch (scripts/delivery/lib/release-branch.mjs).
